spec: content/notes/design-spec.md §12.2 — one row per output id.
notes: crop is in source pixels (left, top, width, height). Boxes were verified against each page image and tightened from the spec estimates so that no slide text or neighbouring tile bleeds in; the tightened value is authoritative.
width is a ceiling: the output is never scaled past the native crop width.

ground: dark = level the near-black ground onto --bg #0B0E13 (measured ground level -> token, 255 stays 255); light = level the border median to --plate-light #E6E7E9; photo = keep the photograph's own ground.
cleared: false means the file is built into the QA directory for review and is NOT written to public/.
